;прозрачно пропускает коды курсива/двойного/подчеркнутого

LINBUF  EQU #BE00
WINBUF  EQU LINBUF+256

NOBYTE=#5CE8
        ORG #6000
        DI
        EI
kolBEG
        LD BC,6144
        LD DE,#4001
        LD H,D,L,C
        LD (HL),L
        LDIR
        LD BC,767
        LD (HL),7
        LDIR
        LD HL,TNUMS
        LD D,#40
CR
        LD A,E
        AND 224
        ADD A,32
        LD E,A
        JR NC,PRTXT
        LD D,72
PRTXT
        LD A,(HL)
        INC HL
        CP 13
        JR Z,CR
        CALL PRSYM
        JR NC,PRTXT
        LD HL,_SKIP
        PUSH HL
        LD HL,_HGT
        PUSH HL
        LD HL,_WIDTH
        PUSH HL
        LD E,#27
VVV0
        LD C,0
        LD (IY-50),C
        LD A,"=
VVVDIG
        CALL PRSYM
VVV
       CALL 8020
       JR NC,VVVQQ
        LD HL,23560
        LD A,(HL)
        LD (HL),H
        LD B,A
        ADD A,-13
        JR Z,vvvok ;CY
        SUB "0"-13
        CP 10
        JR NC,VVV
        LD L,A
        LD A,C
        CP 25
        JR NC,VVV;kolBEG
        ADD A,A,A,A,A,C,A,A,A,L
        LD C,A,A,B
        JR VVVDIG
vvvok
        INC C
        DEC C
        JR Z,VVV
VVVQQ  POP HL
        LD (HL),C
       EXA
        LD A,E
        ADD A,32
        LD E,A
        JP P,VVV0
       EXA
       RET NC
        DI
ALL2END
        LD HL,(NOBYTE),B,H
        INC B
        XOR A
        LD L,A,E,A
        SUB B
        LD D,A
        PUSH DE
        LD D,-1,H,B
        DEC H
        CALL H2PAG
        LD C,17
ALL0END PUSH AF,HL,DE,BC,DE,BC
        CALL OUTME
        LD D,'WINBUF
        CALL LDIR0
       POP BC,DE
        LD A,C
        CALL OUTME,LDIRWIN
        POP BC,DE,HL
        DEC D
        BIT 6,D
        SET 6,D
        LD A,C
        CALL Z,PRVPAG
        LD C,A
        POP AF
        DEC H
        BIT 6,H
        SET 6,H
        CALL Z,PRVPAG
        DJNZ ALL0END
        POP HL
        LD D,B,E,B ;KUDA
KOLOGO PUSH HL
_HGT=$+1
       LD B,0;HX
       LD LX,B
        CALL LINEDN
        DJNZ $-3
       EX (SP),HL
;HL=1st adr from
;(SP)=2nd adr from
KOLO1
        CALL RASTYAG
_SKIP=$+1
        LD B,0
        LD A,32
        CALL PUT
        DJNZ $-5
       EX (SP),HL
        CALL RASTYAG
        CALL PUTCR
       EX (SP),HL
        DEC LX
        JR NZ,KOLO1
;HL=1st adr from (нач 2-й колонки)
;(SP)=2nd adr from (нач след страницы)

       POP HL ;нач след страницы
        LD A,#C ;перевод страницы
        CALL PUT

        CALL GET
        JR NZ,KOLOGO
        LD (NOBYTE),DE
PRVPAG
        SUB 3
        AND 7
        OR 16
        RET
LDIRWIN LD H,'WINBUF
LDIR0   LD E,0,L,E
        LD BC,256
        LDIR
        RET

RASTQ   LD A,32
        CALL PUT
        DJNZ RASTQ
        JR LF
RASTYAG
_WIDTH=$+2
        LD BC,0
RAST0
        CALL GET
        JR Z,RASTQ
        INC HL
        CP 13
        JR Z,RASTQ
        CALL PUT
        CP 27
        JR Z,RASTni-2
        DEC C
        JR NZ,RASTni+1
        CP "-
        JR NZ,RASTni
;трехбайтные
        LD C,1
RASTni  INC B
        DJNZ RAST0
LINEDN
LINEDN0 CALL GET
        RET Z
        INC HL
        CP 13
        JR NZ,LINEDN0
LF
        CALL GET
        RET Z
        CP 10
        RET NZ
        INC HL
GET
        PUSH HL
        CALL H2PAG
        XOR A
        OR (HL)
        POP HL
        RET

PUTCR   LD A,13
PUT
        EX DE,HL
        PUSH HL
       PUSH AF
        CALL H2PAG
       POP AF
        LD (HL),A
        POP HL
        EX DE,HL
        INC DE
        RET

H2PAG   LD A,H
        SET 7,H,6,H
        RLCA
        RLCA
        AND 3
        XOR 1
        INC A
        XOR 18
OUTME
        PUSH BC
        LD BC,#7FFD
        OUT (C),A
        POP BC
        RET
PRSYM
        PUSH DE,HL
        ADD A,A
        PUSH AF
        LD L,A,H,15
        ADD HL,HL,HL,HL
        LD B,8
        LD A,(HL),(DE),A
        INC L,D
        DJNZ $-4
        POP AF
        POP HL,DE
        INC E
        RET
TNUMS
        DB "WIDTH",13
        DB "HEIGHT",13
        DB "SPACING",13
        DB "(break=quit",")"+128
DISPLAY $
